admission: Fresh archive/index-only uv seed, ordinary edit of crates/uv/src/lib.rs, source/lockfile restored, separate private state banks at the same paths and fixed actual tool bytes. Require native correctness tests, successful fresh/original/dirty convergence and equal workload/output classes in both arms. Record native exec and environment parity before instrumenting; validate count totals/self/stderr and zero-exit completion. Keep failed attempts. No sample rejection based on effect size or machine activity.
build: Matched release Cargo builds at a common canonical build path, fixed SDK12 build tools, opt3, ThinLTO, CGU1, debug1, no incremental or PGO/BOLT; same SDK12 compiler, rustdoc and linker drive uv in both arms.
gate: Each fixed eight-pair block must have eight candidate wins and a lower 99% reduction bound strictly greater than 0.1%. Stop that endpoint on its first valid failure. A check PR requires both primary blocks. Claim a test-build win only if both secondary blocks separately pass. Investigate a verified secondary regression before publication.
host: isolated Linux x86_64 worker; original host name withheld
native: Elapsed time from instrumented commands is unusable. Any native wall-time study needs independent fixed prospective pairs on a quiet host.

purpose: Test whether inserting lockfile dependency edges in source-node batches reduces Cargo-parent instructions in ordinary dirty uv check and test compilation.
scope: Cargo parent Callgrind Ir with trace-children=no. The child environment is checked against native execution, using the previously validated parent-only loader adapter. Runtime is pinned to CPUs 0-7. Tests are compiled only.
statistics: Geometric mean of paired candidate/baseline ratios; empirical 99% paired percentile bootstrap interval with 200000 resamples. Compute and report per-block two-sided exact sign p. No pooling, extension or familywise claim.
